title: Windows venv python.exe starts a second process; could the launcher run the interpreter in-process?
author: azchohfi
body_preview: ### Feature or enhancement  On Windows, `Scripts\python.exe` in a venv is `venvlauncher.exe`. It reads `pyvenv.cfg`, starts the base `python.exe` as a child process and waits for it (bpo-34977). On Linux and macOS the venv's `python` is a symlink, so there is one process.  The second process costs about 16 ms on every start. `python -c pass` with python-build-standalone 3.14.4 on an i9-10900K,...
